name: Anthony
source:
Mamber and current vice-president of the Tri-Alphas

Dimwitted, but blames it on a learning disability.

Best friend of Dawe

Is good natured on most occasions or when near Ashley

Doesn't seem to hate the DIKs as much as the rest of the Tri-Alphas.
